title: incident-bot: add SLO toolkit on-call diagnostics helpers and runbook linking improvements
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: on-call engineers need faster, contextual diagnostics surfaced in Slack and PagerDuty incidents. This PR adds a small library of SLO-toolkit helpers used by incident-bot to enrich on-call messages with precomputed diagnostics, and improves runbook linking heuristics to reduce false positives. Summary of changes: adds slo_toolkit/diagnostics helpers for SLI aggregation, windowed error-rate summaries, and top-suspect services; introduces runbook_linker with fuzzy matching and priority scoring; updates incident-bot message templates to include compact diagnostics and quick-runbook links; adds unit and integration tests; documents new helpers in README and SDK reference. Checklist: - [x] implement SLO helpers and runbook linking algorithm; - [x] add unit tests for helpers and runbook linker; - [x] integration tests for Slack/PagerDuty message formatting; - [x] update docs and examples; - [x] run cross-repo lints and fix issues. Backwards compatibility: all new helpers are opt-in; existing incident templates unchanged by default. Related: ENG-2345 (on-call diagnostic improvements), SUP-5123 (customer escalations pointing to missing runbook links).
